unlocked_before.meaning: launch token graduation flag unlocked is true before the pair operation

fee_share_decrease_occurred.meaning: _decreaseFeeShares() was called as users transferred tokens

total_fee_share_before.meaning: totalFeeShare value at the checkpoint before the pair core operation

end_rewards_accrual_unavailable_before.meaning: no way exists to call endRewardsAccrual() to deactivate the rewards pool after graduation

pair_core_operation_completed.meaning: the attempted GTELaunchpadV2Pair core operation (mint, burn, swap, sync) completes successfully rather than being permanently blocked

assumptions: Users transfer tokens permissionlessly after graduation; the report does not name a specific actor.
The pair core operation attempt occurs after totalFeeShare has reached 0 with unlocked = true.
The rewards pool remains active because endRewardsAccrual() cannot be called post-graduation.

unresolved.description: Report describes totalFeeShare reaching 0 narratively rather than as a single transaction checkpoint relative to the pair operation; the plan binds it as a before-checkpoint value.

Whether the pair operation reverts only when accrued fees exist (conditional on _distributeLaunchpadFees being called) is stated conditionally; the plan formalizes the general permanent-block scenario.

limitations: Formalizes only the permanent DoS impact on GTELaunchpadV2Pair core functions; frozen-funds and other downstream consequences are out of scope for this claim.
The specific pair operation (mint, burn, swap, sync) is abstracted into one completion observable; per-function witnesses are deferred to code binding.
The report's inferred intent pair_functions_should_remain_usable is used as the safety property; the rewards-end intent is treated as context, not the selected relation.
